---
title: "Tools and ressources for DACs"
---
This section gathers resources for Argo DACs regarding RT processing. It includes code for float decoding and RTQC, link to discussion forum, DAC meetings information etc. 
If you are looking for DMQC tools please look at the dedicated section.

# Tools 

## Data processing and files creation

- Coriolis Argo RT processing chain  
    - in a container: [https://github.com/euroargodev/Coriolis-data-processing-chain-for-Argo-floats-container](https://github.com/euroargodev/Coriolis-data-processing-chain-for-Argo-floats-container) 
    - the Matlab code: [https://doi.org/10.17882/45589](https://github.com/euroargodev/Coriolis-data-processing-chain-for-Argo-floats-container) 

- Sprof files generation: [https://github.com/euroargodev/matsprof](https://github.com/euroargodev/matsprof) & [https://github.com/euroargodev/pysprof](https://github.com/euroargodev/pysprof)


## Parameters computation

- PAR: 
    - [https://github.com/euroargodev/matIRR2PAR](https://github.com/euroargodev/matIRR2PAR) & [https://github.com/euroargodev/pyIRR2PAR](https://github.com/euroargodev/pyIRR2PAR)
    - [https://github.com/euroargodev/PAR_BGC_Argo](https://github.com/euroargodev/PAR_BGC_Argo)


## GTS encoding
- MEDS BUFR encoder: [https://github.com/trana99/ArgoBufrEncoder](https://github.com/trana99/ArgoBufrEncoder)
- MetOFfice BUFR encoder *(link to come soon)*

## RTQC
- BGC RTQC for CHLA and BBP in python:  [https://github.com/ArgoCanada/medsrtqc](https://github.com/ArgoCanada/medsrtqc)
- Spike test: [https://github.com/ArgoRTQC/matlab_MEDD](https://github.com/ArgoRTQC/matlab_MEDD)
- Radiometry QC: [https://github.com/euroargodev/radiometry_QC](https://github.com/euroargodev/radiometry_QC)
- BBP RTQC: [https://github.com/euroargodev/BBP_RTQC](https://github.com/euroargodev/BBP_RTQC)

## File checker
Argo NetCDF file format checker:  [https://github.com/OneArgo/ArgoFormatChecker](https://github.com/OneArgo/ArgoFormatChecker) 

## Metadata 
- Argo metadata schema: [https://github.com/euroargodev/sensor_metadata_json](https://github.com/euroargodev/sensor_metadata_json)
- Validator: https://github.com/euroargodev/argo-metadata-validator
- Loader: https://github.com/euroargodev/argo-metadata-loader
See more on metadata in the Vocabularies section
*Link to SBS & RBR metadata portals to be added soon* 

## Processing Argo data under ice:
- [https://github.com/euroargodev/ArgoUnderIceArctic](https://github.com/euroargodev/ArgoUnderIceArctic)
- [https://github.com/euroargodev/terrain-following](https://github.com/euroargodev/terrain-following)
- [https://github.com/euroargodev/Coriolis-under-ice-positioning](https://github.com/euroargodev/Coriolis-under-ice-positioning)


# Regular DAC meetings
Since 2025, regular informal DAC meetings have been set-up, to foster discussion, knowledge exchange and collaboration between the various DACs. These meetings are currently co-organised by Candice Hall (AOML/US) Clare Bellingham and Kamila Walicka (BODC/UK). If you would like to suggest a topic for an upcoming DAC meeting, please don’t hesitate to reach out to Candice, Clare and Kamila.
